title: Laser Tattoo Removal Cost in Dubai
h1: Laser tattoo removal cost in Dubai
desc: How much laser tattoo removal costs in Dubai: price per session from AED 750 + VAT, how size and colour affect it and how many sessions to budget for.
answer: At Skin & Laser in Dubai Marina, laser tattoo removal starts from AED 750 + VAT per session for dark or coloured ink. The final price depends on the tattoo's size, and the total depends on how many sessions you need, usually 6 to 12.
body:
## Budgeting for removal

Send a photo of your tattoo on WhatsApp for an estimate. Lightening a tattoo for a cover-up needs fewer sessions than full removal.
faq: Larger tattoos take longer to treat each session.
Yes, priced per session by size.
